title: tier-2 shipped code: the type-1 capsule narrowphase against 0x142ccd7b0

unreachableBranches.why: The support-point path (count > 0) hands the block to 0x142cc9460, which is unread. Every fixture case passes count = 0.

notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/collide.rs (capsule_sweep), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the collision_capsule entry.
The oracle runs the real 0x142ccd7b0 and the harness compares the whole 0x44-byte output pointee byte for byte, so a hit/miss difference is visible.
The unit declares the function's exact extent (0x78a) because the image's .pdata entry stops short of it.

The declared specials cover the degenerate capsule (the sphere fallback at the midpoint), both endpoint sphere recursions, the inside-cylinder/clamped-axis sphere recursion, the inside-with-flag report, the motion-budget exit and a parallel sweep.
acknowledgedGaps: Only the count <= 0 paths are verified. The support-point path (0x142cc9460), types 2, 3 and 4+, the hit policy and the geometry ingest remain open.
